product_metadata.title: NEX Umbrella Rack, Metal Umbrella Holder Free Stand for Home Office Entryway with Water Tray and Hooks, Blue
features: 【Elegant and Fashionable】Hollow-out pattern and the lake blue color, make NEX Umbrella Rack not only for umbrella storage but also an adornment or handicraft
【Detail Design】Hollow-out design can maintain good ventilation, make your umbrella breathe freely, especially keep your home or office clean in rainy days
【High Quality Material】Metal material makes the umbrella holder basket strong and durable, not easy to fall down. The green environmental protection paint prevent the umbrella stand from rust
【Considerate Service】 NEX Umbrella Stand is equipped with movable plastic drip tray to prevent the floor from wetting. Two hooks can be used to hang short or folded umbrellas
【Space-Saving Size】 6.1 x 6.1 x 19.3 inches. NEX Umbrella Stand can accommodate multiple full-length folding umbrellas, canes, dried flowers, painted picture tubes etc
